facts.fact: On 8 October 2026 Egypt's communications and labour ministries signed an MoU for programmes building the digital capacities of Labour Ministry employees at headquarters, directorates, labour offices and training centres.
facts.system: MCIT-Ministry of Labor MoU digital capacity programmes

facts.fact: The MCIT and Labor ministries' MoU of 8 October 2026 provides digital-skills programmes for citizens, particularly graduates, job seekers and vulnerable groups, with internationally accredited certificates.
facts.system: MCIT-Ministry of Labor MoU digital capacity programmes
